name: Inside python-coder (the coder's internal workflow)
summary: The internal workflow python-coder runs when the build pipeline's code step hands it a red baseline: it loads the project conventions / PROJECT_CONTEXT, edits only the ticket's files_touched to satisfy the red baseline, runs doc-enforcer on the changed Python, runs complexity-reduction, runs the suite until it is green, and finally records its sign-off via the signoff skill. This is the agent-altitude drill-down beneath the code step of how-a-ticket-is-built.

steps.label: Load conventions
steps.human:
python-coder loads the project conventions / PROJECT_CONTEXT so it writes code that matches the repo's error-handling, style, and structure rules.

Contract fields and examples (generated)
No JSON handoff: Input is the Python coder prompt plus Markdown CLAUDE.md/PROJECT_CONTEXT and repository conventions; output is the agent working context. No JSON artifact is authored at this reading step.

io_contracts.not_applicable: Input is the Python coder prompt plus Markdown CLAUDE.md/PROJECT_CONTEXT and repository conventions; output is the agent working context. No JSON artifact is authored at this reading step.

steps.label: Implement against red
steps.human:
python-coder edits only the ticket's files_touched to satisfy the red baseline handed over by test-writer.

I/O boundary: These JSON projections show the driver-provided scope and test-writer evidence. The coder changes source files; the intermediate diff is a Git artifact, not a serialized implementation DTO.

steps.label: Doc-enforcer
steps.human:
doc-enforcer runs over the changed .py files to enforce docstring and documentation conventions.

Contract fields and examples (generated)
No JSON handoff: doc-enforcer consumes changed Python files and documentation conventions and returns diagnostics/code edits under its skill contract. This flow defines no JSON diagnostic envelope; the file diff and command output are the artifacts.

io_contracts.not_applicable: doc-enforcer consumes changed Python files and documentation conventions and returns diagnostics/code edits under its skill contract. This flow defines no JSON diagnostic envelope; the file diff and command output are the artifacts.

steps.label: Complexity reduction
steps.human:
python-coder runs complexity-reduction to keep the new code within the repo's complexity budget.

Contract fields and examples (generated)
No JSON handoff: The complexity-reduction skill inspects and refactors source files under the existing complexity budget. Its output is a source diff plus measurements/report text, not an invented JSON score DTO.

io_contracts.not_applicable: The complexity-reduction skill inspects and refactors source files under the existing complexity budget. Its output is a source diff plus measurements/report text, not an invented JSON score DTO.

steps.label: Record sign-off
steps.human:
python-coder records the sign-off via the signoff skill, updating the ticket frontmatter and the Sign-offs checklist together.

I/O boundary: signoff atomically updates Markdown frontmatter and checklist/comments. The displayed JSON is the later readback contract, not the Markdown file contents or an invented signoff-write API.
